Fixed date schema leaks and scheduling collisions by enforcing mutual exclusivity and binding calendar dates to prevent agent hallucinations.
Unified search across the project corpus and per-project documentation with a single navigation layer for consistent user discovery.

days.headline: Ship robust flow evals with Alibaba MAX, strict guards, and auto-failover
days.summary: The team deployed a comprehensive evaluation framework featuring Alibaba MAX integration, rigorous static linting for slot validation, and resilient infrastructure that auto-fails over providers during outages. Key improvements include fixing container slot leaks, enforcing strict conversation invariants, and implementing a multi-layered backstop system to prevent sweep hangs.
takeaways: Implemented a P4 guard that re-reads back slot corrections at confirmation to prevent stale asks, ensuring agents don't re-ask filled slots.
Added static linting rules for delivery addresses and appointment times across multiple flows, promoting P2 defects to error gates to catch fake-completion bugs early.
Configured automatic provider failover from Gemini to Alibaba/DashScope when the primary service flaps, preventing evaluation sweeps from hanging indefinitely.
Enforced a one-beat-per-turn invariant with trace-lint sentinels to catch raw container reprs spoken aloud, eliminating silent container slot leaks.

Created a region-pinned S3 presign flow with self-healing deployment scripts; adapt the `POST /sign-upload` pattern for secure, temporary file access in serverless architectures.
Added L2 feature request scenarios for voice and multi-request validation; leverage the `store-and-forward` logic to decouple high-volume ingestion from downstream processing.

days.headline: Resolved demo blockers and codified M3 utilization tracking
days.summary: The team cleared critical demo path blockages by fixing phone server wiring and resolving RM dispatch latency, while simultaneously refining the M3 utilization tracking system with new filters and dashboard health loops. Key artifacts include codified procedure steps, updated reflexion logs, and a CORS-enabled sidecar for CEO-to-TPM communication.
takeaways: Built a CORS-enabled POST sidecar on port 8766 to enable direct CEO-to-TPM message routing without round-trips.
Codified M3 utilization tracking procedures with extended filters for riff/live and phone/riff scenarios to detect phase regressions.
Created a dashboard health loop and branch-change evidence updates to automate QA run verification and leak detection.
Documented L1/L2 review criteria and emergency standup procedures to standardize trouble ticket resolution and demo gating.

days.headline: Agent Router and Riff ship unified orchestration dashboards and L3/L4 validation
days.summary: The team expanded the Agent Router with comprehensive fleet status dashboards, mobile voice dictation, and role-based org charts, while Riff introduced a full L1-L4 validation runner suite with real-time metrics. These updates unify operational visibility across the fleet and establish a robust testing infrastructure for flow validation.
takeaways: Built a unified fleet status dashboard and mobile voice dictation overlay in Agent Router; reuse the `/api/manager` and `/api/peers/status` endpoints to build cross-service fleet monitoring tools.
Implemented a tiered L1-L4 validation runner system with SHA-256 hashing and quality gate metrics; apply the `ValidationState` and `LevelState` derivation patterns to create modular test pipelines.
Defined 10 role personas and integrated them into an org chart UI; leverage the `role-personas` markdown structure and dropdown picker logic to build role-based access control or user dashboards.
Added tailnet auto-discovery and peer gossip to the mobile dashboard; adapt the `tailnet` discovery mechanism to enable decentralized node registration in your own network layer.

days.headline: Multi-agent coordination and FSM testing infrastructure overhaul
days.summary: The portfolio delivers a robust framework for generating and validating complex FSM scenarios, while simultaneously hardening the switchboard UI and agent orchestration layers. Key contributions include a new path explorer for flow analysis, a stateful fault injection system, and comprehensive acceptance tests across multiple agent levels.
takeaways: Built a `FlowGraph` and `path_explorer` CLI to enumerate bounded paths, detect cycles, and classify flow outcomes, which developers can reuse to validate FSM logic and identify dead ends in state machines.

Implemented a `FaultInjector` with configurable failure rates and canonical failure shapes, enabling builders to inject specific errors into tool calls for robust testing of agent recovery and fault handling.

Created an append-only `promotion ledger` and `coverage_history` module to track cross-batch trajectories and detect regressions, providing a reusable pattern for maintaining test isolation and audit trails.

Developed a `ScriptedScenarioStubClient` and `tool-call synthesis helper` to generate deterministic test cases from persona states, allowing other developers to quickly spin up reproducible scenarios without relying on live LLMs.

days.headline: Multi-project intelligence toolkit with GNN, FOIA, and multi-source ingestion
days.summary: This portfolio delivers a comprehensive intelligence briefing system featuring a multi-project dashboard, advanced GNN correlation, and robust data ingestion from FOIA, NARA, and Blue Book sources. Key contributions include a Graph Store with three-layer deduplication, a 20-slant rotation engine, and a full suite of MCP tools and REST APIs.
takeaways: Built a multi-project configuration system with dynamic tabs and a shared header routing engine; reuse the `PROJECT_ID` build variable and `deploy-project` script to isolate and manage multiple intelligence domains.

Implemented a three-layer deduplication module on a MultiDiGraph with a `GraphDeduplicator` service; apply this pattern to handle duplicate evidence ingestion while preserving source provenance and confidence scores.

Created a modular data ingestion pipeline supporting NARA scraping, NUFORC bulk import, and Blue Book seed documents; adapt the `EvidenceToGraphMigrator` and `GrassyKnollGraphAdapter` to migrate legacy data into your graph engine.

Developed a multi-signal correlation engine with MetaPath2Vec embeddings and anomaly detection; leverage the `MultiDiGraph` structure and `cluster/contradiction` detection logic to build similar signal-fusion systems for your own data.

takeaways: Implemented auto-initialization and fallback logic for GoogleOAuthProvider to ensure reliable token handling when encrypted stores are empty.
Built a War Room Consensus system that synthesizes agent outputs into a unified brief, providing a reusable pattern for multi-agent decision aggregation.
Created a SessionRecorder with per-turn audio capture and segment detection, enabling detailed post-call evaluation and mixed audio support.
Developed an auto-prompt rewriter and action classifier that dynamically adjusts FSM prompts based on evaluation scores, allowing self-modifying agent behavior.

days.headline: Multi-agent AI portfolio: file management, intelligence briefs, and voice scheduling
days.summary: The portfolio delivers a robust file manager with dual-pane layout and terminal integration, while advancing intelligence briefs with narrative footnotes and S3 automation. Simultaneously, a phone agent scheduler introduces live FSM testing, browser voice loops, and natural conversational echo-back.
takeaways: Built a dual-pane file manager with terminal output logging and Claude skill downloads; reuse the two-pane layout pattern for complex dashboard widgets.
Implemented fuzzy signal deduplication via token overlap and recency-first sorting; apply this dedup logic to merge near-identical data streams in your own pipelines.
Created a card-based playbook with inline editing and live FSM state polling; adapt the same-origin proxy pattern for safe in-browser prompt editing and testing.
Engineered a full STT→FSM→TTS voice loop with configurable timing gaps; leverage the idle re-prompt and echo-back validation tests to improve conversational agents.

Established a reusable test suite with stress tests and regression checks, enabling verification of FSM workflows, JSON stripping for TTS, and full-stack reliability.

days.headline: Multi-agent scheduling and RAG platform with domain-aware personas
days.summary: This portfolio delivers a robust calendar scheduling system integrating Google OAuth, security middleware, and AI-driven intent detection alongside a multi-domain RAG tool featuring domain-aware persona cards and audio synthesis. Key reusable components include a two-phase booking confirmation flow, a comprehensive penetration test suite, and a flexible domain-switching architecture for isolated conversation contexts.
takeaways: Implemented a two-phase commit booking flow with overlap detection and Google Calendar integration; reuse the `cal-provider` module to prevent double-booking while handling pending state via file-based persistence.

Built a domain-aware RAG system that isolates evidence retrieval per domain; apply the `PersonaCard` loading pattern and `X-Domain` header strategy to ensure multi-tenant data separation in your own AI agents.

Created a modular test suite with Playwright and scenario-based runners; adopt the `scenarios.json` data-driven approach to rapidly validate edge cases like collision detection or audio pipeline failures.

Established a security-first architecture with rate limiting, audit logging, and CSP hardening; integrate these middleware patterns into your API layer to protect endpoints from bypass attempts and injection vulnerabilities.

Built a WebSocket streaming endpoint with token-by-token delivery and evidence citations for real-time chat interactions.
Created an advanced analytics dashboard with time-series charts, persona effectiveness metrics, and usage statistics.
Added a domain marketplace API with publish, browse, install, and rate endpoints to manage AI domain assets.

days.headline: Sprint 182 ships: idle timeouts, fleet redeploy, and Kokoro TTS phone agent
days.summary: The portfolio delivered Sprint 182 with honest idle-stop messages, a fully redeployed 4-portal fleet, and a new Kokoro TTS-powered phone agent. Parallel work included performance optimizations, user authentication, and a comprehensive AI domain wizard.
takeaways: Implemented honest idle-stop messages that fetch workspace status before claiming sessions to prevent false disconnects.
Executed a complete fleet redeploy across 4 portals with E2E tests passing 4/4, ensuring consistent environment parity.
Built a WebSocket streaming phone agent using Kokoro TTS and 8kHz audio resampling to replace Telnyx speak.
Added user-scoped JWT authentication and an AI domain wizard for generating personas, with extensive E2E test coverage.

days.headline: Sprint 165 wraps RAG tool with full conversation persistence and mobile polish
days.summary: The portfolio delivered comprehensive updates across two major tools, including server-side conversation persistence, persona memory APIs, and a robust mobile-responsive UI. Key features added include conversation export/share endpoints, log streaming via SSE, and extensive E2E test coverage to ensure stability.
takeaways: Implemented server-side conversation persistence and persona memory APIs in the RAG tool, enabling robust state management for split-personality workflows.
Added conversation export, share, and delete endpoints with domain safety to the RAG tool, allowing users to manage and migrate their conversation history.
Integrated SSE endpoints for live log streaming and implemented a 'copy-on-select' feature in the terminal modal for improved developer productivity.
Built a mobile-responsive UI with export/share buttons and comprehensive Playwright E2E tests to validate functionality across all core pages.

days.headline: Sprint 61 API Gateway & Realtime Collab: 61 Sprints of Growth
days.summary: This portfolio spans 61 sprints, delivering a comprehensive suite of features including an API Gateway, GraphQL endpoints, and real-time collaboration via WebSockets. The work also includes significant UI/UX improvements, performance hardening, and a robust backend infrastructure supporting multi-region deployments and plugin ecosystems.
takeaways: Built a unified API Gateway with GraphQL endpoints and a status homepage to streamline access and monitoring.
Implemented real-time collaboration features using WebSockets for domain editing notifications and a dedicated collaborators management UI.
Refined sprint tracking dashboards by parsing narrative summaries, fixing table layouts, and adding pagination for 50+ items.
Established a production-hardened architecture with RBAC, multi-region configuration, and a plugin registry for extensibility.

days.headline: Portfolio indexing, auth, and roadmap automation across three tools
days.summary: This day delivered a fully linked portfolio system with OAuth and admin controls, while simultaneously advancing roadmap tracking and dashboard automation across multiple repositories. Key improvements include auto-generating repo descriptions, securing private repositories, and implementing portable project path handling.
takeaways: Built a portfolio.json indexing pipeline that auto-generates descriptions from READMEs, allowing other developers to automate metadata extraction for their own project catalogs.
Implemented a localStorage-based admin approval system for access requests, which can be adapted for any scenario requiring manual permission gating without server-side dependencies.
Created portable project path handling by storing absolute paths in a central JSON file and expanding them at read time, a pattern useful for managing distributed or containerized environments.
Developed a 'you are here' banner and interactive sprint tabs for roadmaps, providing a reusable UI component for visualizing current progress in iterative development workflows.

days.headline: Bot evolves to auto-rebuild dashboards, support hands-free voice, and secure auth
days.summary: The project introduced hands-free continuous speech with browser-side VAD and echo cancellation, while simultaneously hardening security with Google Sign-In and read-only Telegram modes. New tools now auto-rebuild dashboard data across sprints, and the architecture includes a comprehensive developer docs panel and improved error handling.
takeaways: Implemented hands-free continuous speech using browser-side VAD with echo cancellation and silence thresholds; reuse this pattern for voice-activated assistants requiring low-latency, non-intrusive input.

Added Google Sign-In and read-only Telegram modes to block write tools for unauthenticated users; apply this layered authentication strategy to secure chat interfaces against unauthorized modifications.
Created auto-rebuild mechanisms for dashboard data and sprint status documentation; leverage this approach to keep project tracking dashboards synchronized without manual intervention.
Built a developer docs panel with architecture, setup, and API sections; adopt this centralized documentation structure to improve onboarding and reduce support overhead.

days.headline: 19 sprints of dual-agent evolution: UI polish, multi-provider LLMs, and accessibility
days.summary: The portfolio advanced from foundational multi-provider LLM support and SSE streaming to a fully accessible, mobile-responsive chat interface with comprehensive evaluation frameworks. Key milestones include the implementation of structured seed exports, typing animations, and a generalized tool-chat module, while simultaneously refining ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and error handling across both agents.
takeaways: Implemented a generalized tool-chat module and configurable transport layers (SSE, Telegram) that abstract LLM provider logic, allowing easy expansion to new models like Ollama or Claude without UI changes.
Built a robust e2e integration pipeline with Playwright that validates the discovery-to-seed-doc workflow, ensuring the data flow from user input to structured documentation remains reliable.
Standardized accessibility patterns by implementing ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and mobile-safe layouts, creating a reusable foundation for future feature additions.
Established a sprint tracking system with PROJECT_STATUS generation and automated merge cleanup, enabling consistent progress reporting and conflict resolution across parallel agent branches.

days.headline: Multi-project AI sprint engine with memory, webchat, and publish features
days.summary: The portfolio delivers a unified Afterburner framework connecting Telegram/WhatsApp agents, LLM webchats, and memory systems, while a dashboard automates project publishing and integrates real-time notifications. Key reusable patterns include modular agent architectures, robust CLI tooling, and automated infrastructure provisioning.
takeaways: Modular agent scaffolding with inheritance and principle extraction enables rapid extension of personality and memory systems across projects.
Automated publish pipelines using CloudFront and S3 with one-click deployment reduce manual infrastructure setup for AI dashboards.
Unified CLI and MCP server patterns allow consistent command-line and tool integration across diverse agent backends like Telegram and WhatsApp.
Robust sprint-run scripts with EXIT traps and verification pre-checks ensure reliable execution and prevent cross-project session collisions.

The changes also address OAuth2 proxy permissions and buffer settings to ensure a more secure bootstrap environment.
takeaways: Added automatic database capability detection to seccomp injection to prevent unauthorized system calls in the deployment portal.
Fixed nginx static file permissions in the bootstrap process to ensure files are not world-readable or writable.
Corrected OAuth2 proxy permissions and nginx buffer settings to prevent potential security vulnerabilities in the gateway auth setup.

days.headline: Built a production-ready AWS Cognito auth gateway with Nginx and oauth2-proxy
days.summary: This portfolio update delivers a fully operational authentication gateway integrating AWS Cognito, oauth2-proxy, and Nginx, while simultaneously refining the Website Cloner's S3 handling, deployment modes, and web UI. The implementation resolves critical 404/403 errors, adds robust subdirectory support, and includes comprehensive documentation for manual and automated testing.
takeaways: Integrate oauth2-proxy with AWS Cognito and Nginx to create a secure authentication gateway that handles PKCE and redirects for subdomain deployments.
Implement comprehensive S3 config detection and template depth adjustments to eliminate 404 errors and ensure reliable static asset serving.
Build a web UI with real-time progress monitoring and bulk management features to streamline the cloning and deletion of multiple sites.
Document root cause analysis and systemd service configurations to enable reproducible debugging and production-ready deployment of the auth gateway.

days.headline: Enhanced audio upload support with robust security and template fixes
days.summary: This update expands the system to handle M4B audiobook formats while strengthening OAuth flows and S3 CORS configurations. It also resolves critical template placeholder errors and adds null safety checks across the upload workflow.
takeaways: Added M4B audiobook MIME types and format support to the upload whitelist for broader media compatibility.
Implemented implicit OAuth flow and corrected Cognito domain placeholders in templates to streamline authentication.
Extended S3 CORS headers to include x-amz-meta-* and fixed env var names to prevent cross-origin security errors.
Introduced null checks in upload functions and standardized relative paths for preprocessor scripts to improve stability.
